profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Platform Systems, APIs, Distributed & Multi-Tenant
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 9 years of experience focused on backend and platform systems in Node.js and Java (Spring). I’ve spent the last several years working on multi-tenant platforms, building APIs and services for identity, configuration, and cross-service data.
 
At Roche, I owned and evolved a metadata service used across 20+ applications and designed a global metadata system that enabled shared configuration across platform and application layers. I’ve focused on building systems that are reliable, scalable, and easy for other teams to integrate with.
 
I started in frontend engineering and transitioned into backend and platform development, which shapes how I approach system design. I tend to think about not just how systems work, but how other engineers will use and extend them. I’ve done much of my work in healthcare and am interested in continuing to build systems that have real-world impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Owned and evolved a metadata service powering 20+ applications, supporting tenant-, application-, and user-level configuration in a multi-tenant platform
* Designed and led development of a global metadata system decoupled from application and tenant scope, enabling shared configuration across platform and application layers
* Designed a PostgreSQL-based data model for the global metadata system to support flexible relationships and app-agnostic configuration
* Introduced Redis caching to reduce DynamoDB reads by 11× and improve latency from 120ms to 30ms for key identity endpoints
* Delivered backend APIs in Node.js and Spring Boot for identity, metadata, and token systems, integrating across services in a multi-tenant platform
positions.insights: Skills: Java (Spring Boot) · Node.js · REST APIs · Distributed Systems · PostgreSQL

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed frontend features for a customizable BI analytics dashboard using Angular, including an autocomplete system for SQL-based filter expressions using a grammar-based approach
* Improved performance and stability of dashboard components by optimizing rendering and memory usage for large data sets
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Data Visualization · Angular · SQL

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed Angular-based frontend features, including a PDF export system by rendering a print-optimized view and automating generation with Nightwatch
* Helped establish the company’s first end-to-end UI testing framework using Selenium and Jenkins, enabling automated regression coverage for core user flows
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Selenium · Angular · End-to-end Testing · Jenkins

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Supported technology consulting engagements, contributing to requirements analysis and implementation of solutions for enterprise clients

positions.title: Residential Computer Consultant (RCC)
positions.description: As a RCC, I helped out students in the house with various techinical issues that they had. That was the easy part. The hard part was helping manage a community of 52 students living together in the same house. I helped various residents with different personal problems they were going through or had to be more successful at Stanford. I also helped students with conflicts that arose in the house. All in all, it taught me the importance of listening fully to people's problems and how to provide more tailored and helpful feedback. Many of my residents loved me and the community I was able to help foster.

positions.title: Mobile Team Intern
positions.description:
I worked on a new internal tool that could better deliver a more personal experience to the mobile users.

I worked on both an internal web application in PHP, CSS, HTML, and Javascript, a script in Python to update necessary supporting data, a custom URL call to get back supporting data for the mobile apps in Java, and updated both mobile apps (Android and iOS) using Java and Objetive-C.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Research Assistant
positions.description: I work on creating a more finished and easier to update website and I compile DNA for them, comparing them to national banks of DNA for hits. Some of the projects I have done for the Walbot lab involve a Javascript program that creates a sortable table with dynamic links from a simple text file. On the DNA and bioinformatics side, I work with their probes (samples) of zea mays (corn) and anlyaze it with other databases of DNA and RNA from zea mays to find close hits.

positions.title: Windows Phone 8 Developer Intern
positions.description: I worked on creating new features for the Windows Phone 8 device by working with the Windows 8 architecture across the user interface to the back end. The language I wrote in was a UI markup language that behaved asynchronously to allow data fetches from servers. I finished all my projects given to me, plus two extra projects that are within the company.

positions.title: Cisco Choice Intern
positions.description: I was a summer intern working in the STBU, or Secure Technology Business Unit at Cisco. There, I worked on the Cisco ASA, a enterprise firewall system. My main language I worked in was C, but I also delved into assembly to create a more up to date atomic operation system.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Code Tenderloin is a multipart program that does job readiness, removes barriers for people working to get themselves to a better place, a coding bootcamp, and a sales bootcamp. I work with the coding bootcamp called CodeRamp.

I currently volunteer with CodeRamp as an instructor, tutor, and curriculum improver/former. I have instructed 7 cohorts teaching students base coding skills. I have also tutored 5 different students privately out of my own time. I have had success stories of students who have gone from the streets to a tech job.

I am also working on a new program currently to create a free top quality Coding Bootcamp that would be in competition with for profit boot camps with students being provided the same quality curriculum with same opportunities after.

I got involved when I lived in the Tenderloin and saw the need, and my chance to give back with my specific skill.

projects.title: Personal Agent Platform
projects.description:
Built a config-driven agent platform with a React frontend and Node.js backend, enabling job creation, execution, and run tracking. Designed a modular architecture for agent definitions, tool integration, and execution workflows, with a worker-based model for asynchronous job processing and orchestration.

GitHub: https://github.com/jtsanch/agent-platform

More Details: https://travis-sanchez.vercel.app/work/agent-workflow-engine

volunteerExperience.description:
Code Tenderloin is a multipart program that does job readiness, removes barriers for people working to get themselves to a better place, a coding bootcamp, and a sales bootcamp. I work with the coding bootcamp called CodeRamp.

I currently volunteer with CodeRamp as an instructor, tutor, and curriculum improver/former. I have instructed 7 cohorts teaching students base coding skills. I have also tutored 5 different students privately out of my own time. I have had success stories of students who have gone from the streets to a tech job.

I am also working on a new program currently to create a free top quality Coding Bootcamp that would be in competition with for profit boot camps with students being provided the same quality curriculum with same opportunities after.

I got involved when I lived in the Tenderloin and saw the need, and my chance to give back with my specific skill.
